_comment: Spec-traceability manifest (docs/05 §5.2, docs/06 §6.5). Every normative ID in docs/ is listed here with a status. status=active means the gate REQUIRES >=1 impl annotation (//trace:impl <ID>) AND >=1 test annotation (//trace:test <ID>) in the codebase; status=planned means the ID belongs to a future workstream and is not yet required. The gate also fails on (a) a docs ID missing from this manifest, and (b) a code //trace: annotation referencing an ID absent from docs. As each workstream lands its IDs, flip them planned -> active in the same change. WS0 implements no I-NFT-*/trust IDs, so all are 'planned' here; the mechanism and gate are proven to bite via the WS0 DoD plant.

I-NFT-1.desc: No OP_RETURN in the token carrier; data via push-drop

I-NFT-2.desc: Swap out 0 reproduces token identity byte-for-byte

I-NFT-3.desc: Mint yields exactly one live token UTXO

SC-1.desc: Software key custody via OS keystore/DPAPI

PL-1.desc: Payload confidentiality NOT provided in Stage 1

NET-1.desc: Authenticated secure channel over hostile transport

CH-1.desc: SPV verification path; reorg surfaced not hidden
